ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels localized in radiating linear patterns from the center; ratio approximately 4:1 dark to light.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white radiating streaks originate from the median notch area and extend towards the middle of each lobe. Dark pigmentation dominates the distal regions and leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured interior pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; distinct jagged peaks visible on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a broad convex arc towards a rounded tip; right lobe shows a more acute upward diagonal sweep ending in a tapered point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small circular high-intensity clusters observed along the distal edge of the left lobe and intermittently along the right trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, parallel and intersecting linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the interior white pigmentation on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple deep, irregular notches along the trailing edge consistent with tissue loss; prominent linear scarring across the central ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical white filigree pattern radiating from the notch against a dark ventral background.
